g.text: What goes in spec/, sdk/, and the app
spec/v1/ — NORMATIVE. Anything two independent implementations must agree on.
sdk/ — BINDINGS. Contracts, naming, encoding. No use case, and no concrete pipe.
hub/apps/<name>/ — THE DEVELOPER'S LAYER. application specific blocks
security/ is only this repo's example. The layer is generic — every app supplies all three.
